title: 第八章 你说你和谁求婚了！？（求月票！）
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

深夜，完成学习后，总算能够休息的伊尔莎回到了自己的床铺，躺下打了个哈欠后，几乎立刻就睡着了。

迷迷糊糊之间，似乎是有所察觉，她睁开了眼睛。

就看到了床边，正站着一道黑影。

正是亚枫。

但他此时一套正装，穿着远行披风，左手还抓着一根黑衫木手杖。

“干....干嘛？”

伊尔莎顿时清醒过来，忙起身，下意识地就拉紧了被子，

这大晚上的，他突然跑到自己房间里来...

但这时亚枫丢给了她一件外套，接着说道：

“把衣服穿上，我们出门了。”

“唉？现在？”

“快点。”

伊尔莎只好起床，穿上了衣服，跟随着他出了门。

看了一眼时间，才凌晨两点，月明星疏，吹着凉爽的晚风。

“亚枫，是什么事？我明天还要去上班呢。”伊尔莎打了个哈欠说道。

“还记得之前说过，想要我教你学魔法，得先帮我办一件事吗？”亚枫说道。

“嗯...”伊尔莎点点头。

“那，就跟着我走吧。”亚枫对她伸出了一只手。

伊尔莎犹豫片刻，接着将自己的手伸了过去，和他相握。

瞬间，她整个人像是被猛烈的扯了一把，像是一瞬间被丢出了数百米，整个人落入一股天旋地转的抽离感中。

再睁眼，脚下踩到了结实的地面，抽离感结束，她终于能够呼吸了。

“这，这是...传送术式？”

伊尔莎大口喘息着，观察着周围，发现他们已经来到了一座高峰之上，周围尽是裸露的嶙峋岩石，

气温很低，向下还能看到半山腰间缭绕的云雾，

因为空间类术式的滥用会造成空间的畸变，所以自从三十年前术师法案实施开始，费因王国就一直在严格限制传送法术的使用，属于一级违禁术式，必须由王国统一管辖。

“不是传统的传送术式，这是门钥匙，提前设定好的传送描点。”亚枫走了过去，用黑衫木手杖戳了戳立在悬崖边的一块闪烁着魔力光点的木牌。

“这是个遗留在这里的门钥匙，我只是借用了而已。”他说道。

伊尔莎搓了搓了自己的肩膀，山顶的冷风吹过，她现在有点冷得发抖。

所以，他大半夜的把自己带到这里是做什么？

这时亚枫开始用黑衫木手杖在地上勾画着魔法符文，那是一个繁复的魔法阵，

最后，手杖顶端在魔法阵的核心位置上一点，瞬间，一股淡蓝色魔力流顺着魔法阵的纹路勾勒起来。

接着亚枫从口袋里掏出了一枚灰白色，表面坑坑洼洼的岩石，丢进了魔法阵中，

石头在落地的瞬间就被魔力包裹，紧接着一道淡蓝色的魔力光束直冲云天，宛如一柱信标，在高峰之上升起。

“这是...传唤信标？”伊尔莎认了出来。

这是一种在过去很常见的信息类法术，常用于迷失在荒野中的冒险者之间，创建一个信标点，接着投入一个有着同伴气息的物品，产生的信标光束就可以给身在任何方位的同伴发去消息，同伴也能瞬间感应到信标的位置，与其汇合。

而亚枫刚才投进去的，好像是一枚月相石，一种在法厄坦大遗迹中很常见的岩石，他这是要传唤谁？

“行了，我们在这里等一下吧。”亚枫说道，坐在了旁边的一块岩石上。

现在术式已经完成，他只要等着召唤的对象来到这里就行了。

Page (1/3)

Late at night, after finishing studying, Ilsa, who was finally able to rest, returned to her bed, lay down, yawned, and fell asleep almost immediately.

Drowsily, she seemed to notice something and opened her eyes.

Then he saw a dark figure standing beside the bed.

It was Ya Feng.

But he was now in formal attire, wearing a traveling cloak, and holding a black cane in his left hand.

"What...what?"

Ilsa suddenly woke up, got up quickly, and subconsciously tightened the quilt.

This late at night, he suddenly ran into his room...

But at this time Yafeng threw her a coat and continued:

"Put on your clothes, let's go out."

"Huh? Now?"

"Hurry up."

Ilsa had no choice but to get up, put on her clothes, and followed him out the door.

I looked at the time and saw that it was only two o'clock in the morning. The moon was sparse and the cool evening breeze was blowing.

"Yafeng, what's going on? I have to go to work tomorrow." Ilsa said with a yawn.

"Remember what I said before, if you want me to teach you magic, you have to do something for me first?" Yafeng said.

"Well..." Ilsa nodded.

"Then, just follow me." Yafeng stretched out a hand to her.

Ilsa hesitated for a moment, then stretched out her hand and shook it with him.

In an instant, her whole body seemed to be violently pulled, as if she was thrown hundreds of meters in an instant, and her whole body fell into a spinning feeling of separation.

When she opened her eyes again, she stepped on solid ground, the feeling of detachment ended, and she was finally able to breathe.

"This, this is... a teleportation technique?"

Ilsa panted heavily and looked around, finding that they had reached a peak, surrounded by exposed rugged rocks.

The temperature is very low, and you can still see the clouds and mist lingering halfway up the mountain.

Because the abuse of space spells will cause distortion of space, the Fein Kingdom has been strictly restricting the use of teleportation spells since the implementation of the Magician Act thirty years ago. It is a first-level prohibited spell and must be under the unified jurisdiction of the kingdom.

"It's not a traditional teleportation technique. This is a door key, a teleportation point set in advance." Yafeng walked over and poked a wooden sign standing on the edge of the cliff that was shining with magic light spots.

"This is a door key left here, I just borrowed it," he said.

Ilsa rubbed her shoulders. The cold wind on the top of the mountain blew by, and she was now shivering from the cold.

So, what was he doing bringing himself here in the middle of the night?

At this time, Yafeng began to draw magic runes on the ground with his blackwood cane. It was a complicated magic circle.

Finally, the tip of the cane was at the core of the magic circle, and instantly, a light blue magic flow was outlined along the lines of the magic circle.

Then Yafeng took out a gray-white rock with rugged surfaces from his pocket and threw it into the magic circle.

The stone was wrapped in magic power the moment it hit the ground, and then a light blue magic beam shot straight into the sky, like a beacon, rising above the peak.

"Is this... a summons beacon?" Ilsa recognized it.

This is a very common information spell in the past. It is often used among adventurers lost in the wilderness to create a beacon point, and then throw in an item with the aura of a companion. The generated beacon beam can send a message to companions in any direction. The companion can also instantly sense the position of the beacon and merge with it.

And what Yafeng just threw in seemed to be a moon phase stone, a kind of rock that is very common in the Phaetan ruins. Who is he trying to summon?

"Okay, let's wait here." Yafeng said, sitting on a rock next to him.

Now that the spell has been completed, he just needs to wait for the summoned object to come here.
